Maya (Eng): Heads up 11 I'm planning a phased return from parental leave: back part-time starting 2025-08-04, full-time 2025-11-03. School district announced several unexpected closure days in Sep/Oct; can we carve out single unpaid days without reopening my LOA?
Jun (People Ops): Hi @Maya 11 yes, we typically handle isolated unpaid days as an addendum to the existing LOA so we don't create a new leave window. We need to record them on the LOA addendum so benefits and payroll know to treat those paychecks correctly.
Maya (Eng): Great. Would unpaid single days pause my equity vesting or trigger perf review flags? Don't want accidental side effects.
Ellen (Payroll): For payroll: unpaid single-day LOA entries should be coded LOA-PARENT (addendum). That will preserve health benefits for the month but may change employer 401(k) match for that pay period. For equity/vesting: payroll doesn't control that; Jun will confirm with People Ops/legal.
Tom (Manager): From the manager side, if Maya needs days off that overlap with on-call we need a quick swap plan. Maya, do you know which dates?
Maya (Eng): Tentative: Sep 12, Oct 9, plus 2 floating days between Sep 15 and Oct 30.
PeopleOps Bot: LOA addendum draft created by Maya at 2541238898 11 link: https://intranet.redwood/loa/2541238898
Jun (People Ops): Thanks @PeopleOps Bot. Action items: 1) Maya confirm final dates here (reply). 2) Ellen will pre-load LOA codes so payroll can do 0-hour entries if unpaid. 3) Tom & Maya coordinate on-call swaps and update the team rota. 4) Jun to check equity plan for short unpaid days and confirm. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ellen (Payroll): Will do. I'll also attach a one-page timecard how-to for managers to enter 0-hour unpaid days.
Maya (Eng): Confirming unpaid for the listed dates. Appreciate the quick runbook. :pray:
Jun (People Ops): I'll follow up with a confirmation email and upload the signed addendum to your HR file. Note for everyone: when it's unpaid single days, we do NOT restart the original leave period; it's treated as a linked addendum so continuity is preserved for leave chronology.
Tom (Manager): Thanks team. I'll mark the rota and take the on-call for Sep 12 so Maya is covered.
Jun (People Ops): Closing loop: equity/vesting check 11 short unpaid days under 30 cumulative days in a 12-month period do not pause service per plan doc, but if you cross that threshold we'd treat differently. I'll DM the specific plan citation to Maya. :white_check_mark:
